inputContract: Full real role, profile, Search Brief, Memory and stored Behavior Context captured read-only; private capture is immutable per run.

gold.stage2Population: Exactly the successful stage-one passes, except explicitly recorded evaluation failures
gold.criterionDenominator: Each current criterion covers every successful stage-two evaluation
gold.selectedIdentifiers: Subset of retrieved, eligible candidates successfully evaluated at stage two
gold.errors: Never counted as rejection or hidden
gold.inputMultiplicity: Shared policy and original evidence once per provider request; questions reference shared evidence

privacy: Actual IDs, production text and model outputs only in ignored owner-only runs directories.
limitations: Read-only capture is not a global database snapshot
